title: Different Lands, Different Lives
seo_title: Different Lands, Different Lives Class 4 EVS Worksheet (NCERT Our Wondrous World Ch 9)
standard_code: Class 4, Our Wondrous World Chapter 9: Different Lands, Different Lives
standard_text: Different kinds of land in India (deserts, mountains, plains, coasts, river valleys and deltas); how weather and land shape people's homes, food, clothes, work and transport; plants and animals of different regions; festivals and unity in diversity (summary of NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 9).
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 4 EVS worksheets for NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 9: deserts, mountains, plains and coasts of India, and how land and weather shape homes, food, clothes and festivals. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Land and weather shape how people live.
key_sub: Homes, food and clothes suit each place.
body_html:
How to think about it

India has deserts, high mountains, flat plains, long coasts and river deltas. People's lives suit their land and weather. In the hot Thar Desert, homes have thick mud walls, people wear loose clothes and camels carry loads. In cold Ladakh, people wear wool and keep yaks. In rainy Assam, houses stand on stilts.

Food follows the land too: rice where there is a lot of rain, wheat in the plains of Punjab, fish along the coasts. Harvest festivals such as Bihu, Onam, Pongal and Baisakhi show unity in diversity.

Example

Houses on stilts are used…

floods

Answer: in places with heavy rain, such as Assam

Example

Camels suit…

sand and little water

Answer: the desert

Common mistakes

  • Thinking all of India has the same weather.
  • Thinking deserts are always hot (Ladakh is a cold desert).
  • Mixing up harvest festivals of different states.
